intended_object: An induction/recursion principle for relation series (`RelSeries r`): to build a term of `motive p` for every series `p`, it is enough to handle singleton series and to extend from `p` to `p.snoc x hx`. This is read off the docstring and the `@[elab_as_elim]` attribute.
explanation: This is not a mathematical object. It is an elimination principle, a proof device whose only purpose is to support inductive arguments about `RelSeries`; there is no mathematical object in the literature for it to define. The construction itself is sound. It does strong induction on the length of the series. At length 0 the series equals the singleton on its head. At length d+1 the series equals `p.eraseLast.snoc p.last`, using `snoc_self_eraseLast`. So it matches the docstring, but it is a technical device and not a mathematical definition to judge.
